provenance.artifact_binding: Exact runtime and operational-resource hashes; this receipt and handoff were written after these builds and are not bundled operational resources

implemented.observations: Caller-reported semantic facts, evidence references, audience and current context; contradictory current typed values rejected
implemented.player_projection: Current player facts and eligible choices only; all choices retained with a bounded suggestion shortlist, deterministic narration and separate choice_prompt
implemented.guide_checklist: Explicit source/edition/subject/predicate/value expectations; matching, contradicted, unresolved and pending states; source origins retained without truth voting

method: Player-led choice and delegated autonomy use the same scene/action model
Immediate action requires clear player intent or delegated goal
Description length, decision maker and assistance remain independent
Initial guide/manual pass establishes broad goal and partial nearby expectations
Guide and scene completeness do not gate usable controls
Dot may phrase permitted facts naturally; richer prose does not add game facts
Guide-informed lead exposure remains recorded even with spoiler-light player narration

authored_examples.name: mailbox
authored_examples.narration:
Beside a small mailbox
There is a small mailbox here.
It is mounted on a short post.
The mailbox is closed.
authored_examples.choice_prompt: You can choose: Open the mailbox.

authored_examples.name: station
authored_examples.narration:
Station lobby
A radio rests on a table.
Its dial and speaker are visible.
A key hangs on the wall.
The key is attached to a small hook.
A doorway is visible to the north.
Another doorway is visible to the east.
authored_examples.choice_prompt: You can choose: Inspect the radio; Take the key; Go through the north doorway. 1 more option is available.

authored_examples.name: barrel
authored_examples.narration:
A room with a barrel
There is a wooden barrel in the room.
Dark hoops run around its sides.
authored_examples.choice_prompt: You can choose: Look inside the barrel.

extra_checks: Guide/internal/stale text never enters player data
Changed source/resource/scene/observation identity rejects old selection
Guide majority cannot override current observation
Condition text is not evaluated from apparent context
Ordinary current route remains available without facts or guides
independent_review.scope: Read-only source review and authored offline checks

cases: Unambiguous open-it avoids repeated menu and observes actual result
Station radio choice proceeds with incomplete/conflicting guide coverage
Detailed barrel description does not expose hidden contents or execute look
Short narration and bounded autonomous delegation remain separate settings
Takeover invalidates old input intention while retaining meaningful goal
One guide or partial scene does not block an applicable ordinary action
Ambiguous target requires a game-facing clarification; cinematic style cannot invent affordances
clarifications_after_review: Target must be uniquely identifiable, including zero-target case
Reconstruction oracle means candidate progression and checks the game can confirm or contradict
Consumer uses complete permitted facts/choices, not narration string alone
instruction_forward_test.scope: Authored instruction/contract behavior; no live recognition, speech or player-latency claim

limitations: Observations, audience labels, source identity, guide edition and route applicability are caller assertions, not independent scene recognition.
The checklist does not automatically extract guide prose, unify differing entity labels or evaluate conditions.
Exact document/observation checks cannot detect a caller incorrectly reusing an old observation as current.
Choice selection returns metadata only; no ownership grant, input execution, transition or outcome is implied.
Natural-language intent resolution, autonomous goal planning and speech remain Dot/adaptor integration work.
The authored examples and their source/route references do not qualify any commercial game.
No real game guides were collated for a selected commercial edition in this generic-method slice.
No original-Dot desktop, native guest, tunnel or ownership publisher was operated.
The final native payload, live observation/action path, voice availability and measured interaction delays remain separate acceptance gates.
No merge, release, automatic repository synchronization or personal skill installation was performed.
